answer:
Verdict: no

Over the whole trace (0–30,694 ms), the sampler’s cycle lengths **varied throughout**, rather than steadily increasing. The mean was 5.500 ms in the first tenth and 5.642 ms in the last tenth—a 1.03× increase, far short of 2×. CPU work per cycle was steady, changing from 0.265 ms to 0.268 ms (1.01×).
